content: Oburhè burhali cici embere z’obushinganyanya
Okubundi Bildadi w’e Shwahi, anacijà eluhya, aderha, erhi:
Mangaci weki waleka ebîrà binwa byâwe? Orhangigerereza buzinda rhubulikubwîra, rhuganîre.
Cirhumire odwîrhe warhulola nka nyama, rhwamayôrha nka binganyi omu masù gâwe!
We dwîrhe wacibâga erhi burhè burhuma, K’omanyire mpu igulu lyayôrha kwône erhi we rhuma, Ka wamanya mpu ibuye likola lyakûlwa omu bululi bwalyo?
Nêci, obulangashane bw’omwîsi bwahirigirha, n’engulumira y’omuliro gwâge erhakacimoleka bundi.
Obulangashane bwazima omu nyumpa yâge, itara lyâge lyazimîra enyanya ly’irhwe lyâge.
Okulambagira kwâge n’emisî kwahwa, n’ihano lyâge yênene lyo lirhumire akûmba.
Bulya amagulu gâge gamâgwârhwa n’emigozi, amâlambagira omu kasira.
Omurhego gwamâmugwârhira oku kansisira n’empulula yagwo yamâmusêza.
Guli mufulike ekuzimu omugozi gumurhezire, n’omurhego gwamurhuluba guli omu njira yâge.
Ngasi lunda ankayêrekera obwôba bwâmugwârha, bunamushimbulwîre oku ajà agenda.
Ishali bwo buhane bwâge, n’obuhanya bwamâmuja aha burhambi.
Oluhù lw’ebirûmbu byâge loshi lwalîbirwe, ebirûmbu byâge byamalîbwa n’enfula y’olufù.
Amâkûlwa omu nyumpa yâge, omu ànalicibêrîre n’omurhûla, akululirwa emwa mwâmi wa bakahèza.
Wanahashig’iyûbaka omu nyumpa yâge bulya erhaciri yâge, ecibiriti camâlashirwa aha mwâge.
Omu nshishi, emizî yâge yamâyûma, omu nyânya, amashami gâge gamâgokômba.
Arhakaciyibukwa hano igulu, arhacigwêrhi izîno omu cihugo.
Bamâmurhenza omu bulangashane, amâja omu ndunduli, amâkagwa hanôl’igulu.
Arhacigwêrhi ehy’omwîmo, oli ehy’iburha omu lubaga lwâge, ntâye wafulumusire olufù omu lugò lwâge.
Omu kubona okwôla ayôsire, abantu b’e Buzika-zûba bamârhemuka. Nabo abantu b’ebuzûka-zûba, bamârhungwa n’obwôba.
Kwo habà ntyo, aha mw’enkola-maligo; kwo hayôrha ntyôla aha mw’omuntu orhayishi Nyamuzinda.
